common.footnote: Your interests. Your company. Your pace.

slides.title: Marrakech,
slides.copy: A courtyard café, a turn through the souks, a view over the rooftops. Take time for the Marrakech that catches your eye, with a journey planned around you.
slides.label: MARRAKECH, MOROCCO
slides.line: Above the rooftops, before the day begins.

slides.title: Take a closer look.
slides.copy: Carved cedar, hand-laid zellige and the quiet of a riad courtyard. Some of Morocco’s most beautiful moments are the ones you stop to notice.
slides.label: MOROCCAN CRAFT & ARCHITECTURE
slides.line: The care is in the details.

slides.title: A little longer
slides.copy: Follow Essaouira’s ramparts to the fishing port, find a table for lunch and let the afternoon unfold. There’s always time for another walk along the shore.
slides.label: ESSAOUIRA, MOROCCO
slides.line: Sea air, blue boats and an open afternoon.

slides.title: Out of the city,
slides.copy: Walk beneath olive trees, pause above the cascades and stay for lunch by the water. Ouzoud makes a beautiful day away from Marrakech.
slides.label: OUZOUD WATERFALLS, MOROCCO
slides.line: A path through the trees, the sound of water.

slides.title: Another side
slides.copy: Blue walls, green palms and the light of a garden morning. Make room for Majorelle and the quieter corners of the city between your medina walks.
slides.label: MAJORELLE GARDEN, MARRAKECH
slides.line: Color and a moment of calm.
